debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term moving average structure (EMA 50/200, SMA 50/200) remains bullish and price holds above SMA 200, providing macro support framework for eventual recovery as oversold conditions are extreme.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme oversold oscillators (RSI 9: 14.92, Stoch K: 12.01) with zero bullish recovery signals, negative MACD, weak ADX (22.44), and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 234.4, earnings risk in 43 days) create a confluence of near-term and systemic risks that overshadow long-term structure.

decision.entry_rationale: While AMGN trades at support with long-term MA structure intact, extreme oversold oscillators (RSI 9: 14.92, Stoch K: 12.01) lack bullish recovery confirmation and offer no reliable swing entry signal in current macro crisis environment.
